fuel_consumption.source_quote: Our 2008 forecasted mainline and Express fuel consumption is approximately 1.57 billion gallons and a one cent per gallon increase in fuel price results in a $16 million annual increase in expense, excluding the impact of hedge transactions.

instrument_type_details.notes: Costless collar transactions on heating oil futures. Weighted average collar range $2.05 to $2.25 per gallon of heating oil for 2008 positions. 10% heating oil price increase would increase fair value by ~$85M; 10% decrease would decrease by ~$75M.
